sweep: 5b — the concierge chat lane on the run page, across every run state
whatItIs: the left column of every run detail page. The tabs (Preview/Steps/Files/Workspace/Audit) are the RIGHT pane; the lane is beside them and persists across all five tabs and all five run-detail URLs. It is not a tab and not a modal.

testidSurface.note: unlike /runs (which has ZERO testids — D-14), the lane is thoroughly instrumented. Use these, not text.

textarea.name: run-chat-message
textarea.placeholder: Ask for a change or a follow-up…

composer.enableRule: chat-send is disabled while the textarea is empty and enables on the first character; clearing it disables again. Verified by dispatching input events, without sending.

message.note: every message on every run captured carried data-role='narrator'. No 'user' or 'assistant' role was produced by any seeded run — sending a message is the only way to create one, and that costs an LLM call.

narratorVocabulary: Before I build, I need to lock a few things down.  → Answer in Steps
Cancelled by you                                   → Open in Steps
What went wrong                                    → Open in Steps
Deliverable / Delivered — open in Preview →        → Open in Preview

adornments.label: 'Run summary' + '<n> agents · <deliverable filename>' — the label does NOT change with state, only aria-expanded does
revealsWhenExpanded: lane-pipeline-mini (PIPELINE · N AGENTS, per-agent durations, 'Open Steps →')
adornments.note: lane-adornments is in the DOM in BOTH states; only its contents change. Assert on aria-expanded or on lane-pipeline-mini, never on the presence of lane-adornments.

chainSuggestions.heading: TAKE THIS FURTHER
chainSuggestions.note: the -beta variant is a SEPARATE testid, not a modifier on the base one. A selector on chat-chain-suggestion-chip alone misses it; a prefix selector catches both.

defects.D-19: composer availability is inconsistent across terminal states. A FAILED run keeps a fully enabled composer; CANCELLED and DIVERTED runs have chat-composer in the DOM but no textarea and no send button at all. Three terminal states, two different contracts, no visible rule.
defects.D-21: the completed prototype run's transcript repeats itself: 'Before I build, I need to lock a few things down.' and 'Clarifications answered' each appear TWICE, with different data-message-ids. Two clarification rounds would explain it, but the pairs are identical in text and offer the same action.
defects.alsoNoted: a DIVERTED run's lane never names the workflow it diverted to, and offers no link to the resulting run. Its last message is 'Review approved — build continues', which is what a non-diverted gate approval says too — the lane gives no way to follow the handoff.

staleTestid.tab-thinking: the Steps tab's testid is still tab-thinking. Confirms D-08 — the stale 'Thinking' name survives in the testid and has leaked into the cancelled run's user-facing copy.

notCaptured.userAndAssistantRoles: sending a message triggers a live LLM turn — real cost, and on a gated workflow it can create a gate only a human should answer. Flagged rather than spent.
notCaptured.waitingForUserLane: the one seeded run that was waiting_for_user has since completed. The 'Answer in Steps' affordance is captured; the blocking gate state is not.
